theorems.name: Submission.cmcsd_dyadic_series_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (c₄ : NNReal) (Λ : ℕ → NNReal), (∀ j, (Λ j : ℝ) ≤ c₄ * 2 ^ j) → (∀ (C : NNReal) (A : ℝ≥0∞) (p q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞), p ≤ q → a 0 ≤ A → (∀ j, a (j + 1) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (q + 1))) * A) → ∑' j, (2 * (Λ j : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ p * a j ≤ (2 * (c₄ : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ p * (1 + C) * A) ∧ (∀ (K A : ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞), K ≠ ∞ → A ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, z j ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((j + 2) * (p + 1))) * A) → Tendsto (fun j => (2 * (Λ j : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ p * z j) atTop (𝓝 0))
